question: This is the third time I am writing. Your delivery is late AGAIN and nobody answers. I am done with you people.
note: L0 v3 distress rule: the KB fully answers 'how do I track a late order', so a confidence-driven escalation here would be luck, not tone recognition - hence expectEscalationReason. CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT also passes: v12 labels a late order that way

question: I am going to report you to the consumer rights authority and post this on Facebook if this is not fixed today.
note: threat of escalation outside the channel - a human must own this, whatever the KB says

question: my father is in hospital and the medical device I ordered has not arrived, I am panicking
note: distress with real-world harm - the highest-cost case to get wrong

question: you people are thieves, you took my money and sent a broken phone
note: accusation of fraud plus a defective item - the KB answers the defect half, tone decides the handoff. CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT also passes: v12 labels a defective item that way

question: just give me a human, I do not want to talk to a bot
note: explicit handoff request - the pre-existing D13 path, kept here as the reference point

question: ei order ta niye ami khub birokto, tomader service kharap
note: anger in romanized Bangla - tone detection must not be English-only. CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT accepted cycle 3: the message is angry about an order, and v12 labels an order problem CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT (1/5 runs); the escalation itself is what this case tests

question: my parcel arrived smashed, the screen is cracked, this is unacceptable
note: annoyed but not distressed, and the KB answers precisely. Either a clean answer or a handoff passes; inventing a different remedy does not

question: hi, my delivery seems to be running late, could you check?
note: CONTROL: a calm customer with the same underlying problem. Guards against an agent that escalates every complaint - the failure mode the distress rule could easily cause

question: the item I got is defective, what are my options
note: CONTROL: negative sentiment about a product is not distress. Expectation REFRESHED cycle 3 (resolve -> any + reason CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT): prompt v12 (l0-platform-system-prompt.ts, the CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT paragraph) deliberately makes a calm report of a defective item a CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT handoff even when the KB answers it, so escalating with the answer is documented behaviour, not a false escalation (4/5 runs). The control still bites: CUSTOMER_DISTRESS here fails, and mustContain still applies to any turn that does not escalate

question: how long do refunds take once you receive the return
note: CONTROL: neutral question in a corpus full of angry ones
